exposure: Potential risk of infection (maternal risk factors)
cohort: 712 hospitalised neonates investigated with blood cultures for suspected infection at a neonatal unit.
finding: Proven bloodstream infections in hospitalized neonates were predominantly healthcare-associated, had a higher mortality rate compared to presumed or potential infections, and Gram-negative pathogens were associated with a 3-fold higher odds of death.
birth_weight: Measured; neonates with proven BSI had lower birth weight.
